title: Attribute Modify
description: This mod allows the modification of item attributes, both vanilla and curios. Do you want to buff or nerf a weapon or curios? With this mod, you only need a datapack to do so.
body:
# AttributeModify

Modify item attributes through datapacks. Supports mining speed, mining tier, durability, and optional Curios or Accessories integration.

## Features

*   Add, modify, or remove item attributes
*   Override mining speed and mining tier
*   Override durability and custom durability triggers
*   Works with vanilla and modded items
*   Multiplayer friendly and `/reload` compatible

## Datapack Location

Place files in:

```
data/<namespace>/item_attributes/<file>.json
```

## Special thanks to 4ns0n on Discord for making the icon and changing the generation to AI that it had.

## Support

Detailed documentation and version-specific examples are shared on Discord.
